C1.worst_defect: The hero carries a four-line centred paragraph plus a second small-print line under the buttons ("Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first..."). That makes two text blocks around the CTAs, and the top-nav label "At the till" means nothing to a first-time visitor.

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table says the demo's only traffic is "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com". That is a domain from another brand, never explained anywhere on a VendurePOS site, so a reader is left asking who runs this.
C2.where: home/desktop/02, 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; connect-a-till/desktop/01 'Where requests go'

C3.worst_defect: The quick start never shows success visually. Step 8 (a–i) and 'Check it worked' are text only, with no screenshot of the till's Sign in to Vendure form or of the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard, so the reader has to picture the target state.

C4.worst_defect: The reference pages are dense walls of text. In Troubleshooting, 'Till updates line' nests bold lead-ins, a collapsed details block and an errorCode bullet list inside one bullet. The Changelog bullets are strings of code pills ("order.create v5 shipping: ... tally-in-store ... tallyShipping ... shipping_single (ADR 0005)") that are hard to scan.

C5.worst_defect: In the 'What it does today' grid, the nine unboxed features in two columns leave 'Custom items, fees and shipping' orphaned alone in the left column with an empty cell beside it. The section also switches from two bordered cards to unboxed text with no visual reason.
C5.where: home/desktop/02 (top), continuing from home/desktop/01 bottom; same in home.desktop-dark

C6.worst_defect: On a phone, 'What it does today' becomes 11 identical bold-heading-plus-grey-paragraph blocks with no icon, divider or rhythm change, about two full screens of undifferentiated text. Quick-start step headings wrap to three lines ("2. Add TallyPosPlugin to your existing Vendure config") with a code chip inside the H2.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse on / still flags unused-javascript (est. 53 KiB) and render-blocking requests (est. 120 ms), with LCP 2.3 s. The share card's screenshot is cut through the product cards at the bottom edge and never mentions pre-release.

overall_worst.defect: In the home page's 'What it does today' grid, the nine plain features sit in two columns, so 'Custom items, fees and shipping' hangs alone on the last row with an empty right-hand cell. On the page every visitor sees first, this is the one visible layout fault. It repeats in dark mode.
overall_worst.fix: Lay the nine unboxed features out in a 3-column grid at desktop widths so they fill a 3x3 block, or drop or merge one item so the 2-column grid ends on an even count.
